features: Node.js service supporting email, SMS, and push notifications
prompts.label: notification service blueprint
prompts.purpose: backend notification service blueprint (not a website build)
prompts.raw: Create a notification service using Node.js supporting email, SMS, and push notifications. Implement user notification preferences, delivery scheduling, retry logic for failures, notification templates, and delivery tracking. Add rate limiting per user and notification batching for efficiency.

features: Node.js service with AWS S3 integration
prompts.label: file upload service blueprint
prompts.purpose: backend file upload service blueprint (not a website build)
prompts.raw: Create a file upload service using Node.js with AWS S3 integration. Implement multipart upload, image compression, thumbnail generation, and presigned URL generation. Add file type validation, size limits, virus scanning, and CDN integration for serving files.
